description: Builds host connection profiles from aliases and connection settings, deriving the hostname, user-qualified connection target, and remote transport arguments.

cases.expected_output:
alias=host
hostname=hostname
connection=remote_user@hostname
remote_user=remote_user
port=22
config_file=~/.ssh/config
identity_file=~/.ssh/id_rsa
forward_agent=true
ssh_multiplexing=true
ssh_arguments=-A -p 22 -F ~/.ssh/config -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa -o BatchMode=yes -o Compression=yes

alias=host
hostname=host
connection=user@host
remote_user=user
port=2222
forward_agent=true
ssh_arguments=-A -p 2222

alias=host
hostname=host
connection=host
identity_file=new_value
ssh_arguments=-i new_value

alias=host
hostname=host
connection=test_user@host
remote_user=test_user
port=22
ssh_arguments=-p 22
